limitations: Stage 2 v7 incorporates six source-checked SPC editorial summaries as L1-only records. They are not verbatim judgment text, have no invented claims or source spans, and do not enter the 54 deep records. Unknown final judgment dates stay null.

LexRel relation subjects do not establish litigant roles, and abstract relation rights/obligations do not establish actual requested remedies. Claims use only explicit source facts; missing demands are identified as not annotated.

Stage 2 v6 corrects explicit demand amounts, decimal/grouped/unit amounts, current dispositions and source-span boundaries. A source-only correction does not upgrade maturity or establish complete legal review.

Separate explicit disposition sections are retained verbatim in facts_text because CaseIndexRecord has no disposition-text field. Indexed text is source material, not a claim that every sentence is a court finding. Affirmances without a restated amount and complex multi-claim outcomes remain limited. Interest subtotals, competing demands and periodic payments are not treated as a single case total; ambiguous amounts stay null.
Machine-extracted L1 cases are not human-verified; L2 requires REVIEWED_L2_CASE_IDS.
Citations that are not Civil Code articles 1-1260 are not written to related_provision_ids and are not retained as raw citations in this dataset.

Every legal-rag civil case and every LexRel expert-annotated 服务合同关系 sample remains a deep CaseRecord for text retrieval. Refund-rule condition bridges are limited to SERVICE_REFUND_COMPARISON_CASE_IDS. The gym refund rule is invoked only for prepaid-closure / 解除+返还 cases in that set. LexRel train splits are unused.

Holdings, reasoning steps, and court findings are omitted when they cannot be anchored in 法院经审理查明/法院认定, 裁判理由, or the judgment 主文. 诉称 and 辩称 are never written as CourtFinding records. UNKNOWN conditions mean the source does not establish the predicate; they are not NOT_SATISFIED.
CourtFinding records are taken from 法院经审理查明/法院认定, never from 诉称 or 辩称.
Condition mapping is conservative machine heuristics and always sets human_verified=false.
